description: This file defines the WorkflowScreen widget for a Flutter application, responsible for displaying and managing a list of workflow steps for a site. It includes UI components such as an AppBar, ListView, and ListTiles, and manages state interactions such as fetching workflow steps, marking steps complete, and handling loading/error states.

classes.name: WorkflowScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of workflow steps for a specific site and allows marking steps as complete.

classes.name: _WorkflowScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing the UI and interactions for WorkflowScreen, including fetching data and rendering UI components.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers fetch of workflow steps for the given site.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the screen, including app bar, list of steps, and loading/error handling.

methods.name: _trailingForStatus
methods.description: Determines the trailing widget for each step based on its status, providing a completion button or status chip.
